company.name: Mambu
company.shortDescription: Mambu is the only true SaaS cloud core banking platform.
company.description:
Heard of composable banking? The concept originated here at Mambu. We’ve been champions of composable for over a decade.
Mambu is the only true SaaS cloud core banking platform. Our unique and sustainable composable approach means that independent engines, systems and connectors can be assembled in any configuration to meet business requirements and the ever-changing demands of your customers. 200+ banks, lenders, fintechs, and even retailers in 60 countries turn to us to help them build modern digital financial products faster, securely and cost-effectively.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-native, composable SaaS core banking platform for configuring, launching, and managing deposits, lending, payments, and other financial products through APIs.
productsAndServices.name: Mambu Core Banking Platform

productsAndServices.description: A configurable lending platform for consumer, business, mortgage, embedded, and purchase-finance products, supporting loan origination, servicing, repayments, arrears, and portfolio management.
productsAndServices.name: Mambu Lending

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-native deposits platform for current accounts, savings, term deposits, wallets, and stored-value products, with configurable rules, automated servicing, and real-time transaction support.
productsAndServices.name: Mambu Deposits

productsAndServices.description: A payments platform combining payment orchestration, processing, reconciliation, bank and scheme connectivity, and a universal gateway through APIs and a centralized control layer.
productsAndServices.name: Mambu Payments

productsAndServices.description: Fully managed cloud infrastructure for running regulated financial services, including true SaaS delivery, multi-cloud deployment, automated scaling, backups, redundancy, and platform updates.
productsAndServices.name: Mambu Cloud Services

productsAndServices.description: A managed SaaS foundation for launching partner-led banking products, including wallets, deposits, lending, payments, and embedded financial services.
productsAndServices.name: Mambu Banking as a Service

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series E round raised $265,401,174, or 59.2% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,845,353 to $5,533,896,812, a 1439.11x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 69 (-22 over 90 days) and market heat at 68 (+1).

caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
